answer: A hollow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vertex of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the atlas of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, slashed on a failed audit.
